# The yahoo-prices feed

Yahoo Finance daily prices of the US equities companies (internal use only).

The daily price history of every us-equities company, read through Drishti's own us-equities-prices connector so the documents have exactly the pack's shape. For internal use only.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | Yahoo Finance (https://finance.yahoo.com) |
| Licence | [Yahoo terms of service (personal use, no redistribution)](https://legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/terms/otos/index.html): **internal only** |
| Notes | Yahoo's terms forbid redistributing its prices; the owner approved internal use inside the bank only (2026-10-29) |
| Lake | `capitalmarket` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | weekdays at 22:30 (local time); **off** as shipped (`enabled: false`) |
| Pull | `us_equities.YahooPricesFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/us_equities.py); 2 s between requests, 3 retries |
| Keys | `token` from `${DRISHTI_TOKEN}` (optional) |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run yahoo-prices --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run yahoo-prices                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/yahoo-prices/<date>/, load into capitalmarket
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status yahoo-prices             # its last runs
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md](../../docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md).

## Data contract

### price-history

Pack `us-equities`, kind `price-history` (Price history (live, internal use only)), table `price-history`; files `data/datafeeds/yahoo-prices/<date>/price-history.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

A company's daily prices.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AS_OF` | unknown | optional | When PRICE last traded, as text: local date and time and the exchange's time zone (Yahoo chart meta regularMarketTime). |
| `CHANGE` | unknown | optional | PRICE minus the previous close, gain positive, in CURRENCY. |
| `CHANGE_PCT` | unknown | optional | The change as a percentage of the previous close, in percent (0.43 is 0.43%). |
| `CURRENCY` | unknown | optional | The currency of the prices, ISO 4217 (Yahoo chart meta currency). |
| `DAY_HIGH` | unknown | optional | The session's highest price, in CURRENCY (Yahoo regularMarketDayHigh). |
| `DAY_LOW` | unknown | optional | The session's lowest price, in CURRENCY (Yahoo regularMarketDayLow). |
| `EXCHANGE` | unknown | optional | The exchange's name as Yahoo gives it (fullExchangeName, else exchangeName). |
| `FIFTY_TWO_WEEK_HIGH` | unknown | optional | The highest price over the last 52 weeks, in CURRENCY (Yahoo fiftyTwoWeekHigh). |
| `FIFTY_TWO_WEEK_LOW` | unknown | optional | The lowest price over the last 52 weeks, in CURRENCY (Yahoo fiftyTwoWeekLow). |
| `MARKET_STATE` | unknown | optional | The market's state when fetched: Yahoo's marketState as given, else REGULAR or CLOSED from the regular trading period, else UNKNOWN. |
| `PRICE` | unknown | optional | The last traded price, in CURRENCY (Yahoo regularMarketPrice, else the last bar's close). |
| `VOLUME` | unknown | optional | The session's traded volume in shares (Yahoo regularMarketVolume). |
| `ANALYTICS` | record | derived | Computed from the closes when the history is read (PXH analytics): nested ANALYTICS |

The contract: `config/packs/capitalmarkets/us-equities/contracts/price-history.contract.yaml` ([us-equities](../../docs/contracts/packs/us-equities.md)).
